**Repeat suppression is in.** `route()` keeps a last-sent time per `key` in [src/router.js:31](src/router.js:31).

A key that just delivered stays quiet for 5 minutes. Only real sends update the clock, so a suppressed repeat does not extend the window.

Replay is clean. 900 events, zero errors, 99 dropped as flaps. I read "in the last 5 minutes" as a gap under 5 minutes. Tell me if you want 5 exactly to also drop.
